release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.7.4 (Build 67): Animated Sliding Capsule Navigation & Native Motion Transitions.
• Sliding Pill Navigation: Smooth horizontal spring indicator gliding across tabs on switch, with tactile micro-bounce icon scaling.
• FocusDefend Branding & Curated Tabs: Today (Dashboard), Study (Sprints), Analytics (Deep Insights), Rewards (Token Shop), Profile (Family Link).
• Live Real-Time Integration: Instant database synchronizations across student and parent portals.
